name: tesseract
description: Open-source OCR engine for text recognition from images with machine learning capabilities

tesseract.description: Optical Character Recognition engine converting images to searchable text with multi-language support
tesseract.usage:
tesseract image.png output # Extract text to output.txt
tesseract document.jpg result -l eng+ron # OCR with English and Romanian
tesseract scan.tif text -c preserve_interword_spaces=1 # Preserve spacing
tesseract photo.jpg output --psm 6 # Assume uniform block of text
tesseract receipt.png data tsv # Output as TSV with coordinates
tesseract form.jpg output pdf # Create searchable PDF
tesseract page.png result -c tessedit_char_whitelist=0123456789 # Numbers only
tesseract --list-langs # Show available languages
tesseract image.jpg stdout quiet # Output to console, suppress messages
tesseract complex.png text --psm 3 -c preserve_interword_spaces=1

text2image.description: Training data generator creating synthetic images from text for Tesseract model training
text2image.usage:
text2image --text='Sample text' --outputbase=training --font='Arial' # Generate training images
text2image --textfile=corpus.txt --outputbase=dataset --fonts_dir=./fonts # Batch generate from file
text2image --text='Numbers 123' --outputbase=digits --exposures='0 1' # Multiple exposures

combine_tessdata.description: Tesseract training data combiner for creating and extracting .traineddata files
combine_tessdata.usage:
combine_tessdata -o lang.traineddata lang.* # Combine training components
combine_tessdata -e lang.traineddata lang # Extract components from traineddata
combine_tessdata -d lang.traineddata # Display traineddata file info
combine_tessdata -c lang.traineddata # Check traineddata file integrity

lstmtraining.description: LSTM neural network trainer for creating custom Tesseract recognition models
lstmtraining.usage:
lstmtraining --traineddata=base.traineddata --net_spec='[1,36,0,1 Ct3,3,16 Mp3,3 Lfys48 Lfx96 Lrx96 Lfx256 O1c105]' --model_output=custom # Train LSTM model
lstmtraining --continue_from=checkpoint.checkpoint --traineddata=lang.traineddata # Resume training
lstmtraining --stop_training --continue_from=model.checkpoint --traineddata=base.traineddata # Finalize model
